identity.label: Identity mark
identity.hint: A beneficiary application form needs all seven identity marks, each on one question. A mark sets the question's type and keeps it required.
identity.blocked: A question in an official-only or conditional section takes no identity mark.
identity.locked: An identity question is seen by everyone, so it takes no condition.
identity.section: This section holds identity questions, so everyone sees it.

builder.score_hint: The points this answer gives toward the priority score. Leave empty if none.
builder.score_ranges_hint: The answer gets the points of the range its number falls in. If it falls in more than one, the first counts.
builder.scoring_intro: The score is optional. When questions carry points, the office's list is sorted by score. Volunteers and applicants never see the points.
builder.scoring_not_assisted_hint: Given to a person with no application approved in an earlier project of this program.
builder.scoring_over: The points add up to more than 100. Lower some before publishing.
builder.calc_formula_help: Write with question names, numbers and + − * / ( ), for example: cash + bank. For a condition, if(…, …, …).
builder.calc_results_help: When the result is a text rather than a number, add the results here, for example “Severe poverty”.
builder.calc_results_note: To give this result in a step, choose “A text result” as the part's kind.

builder.count_from_hint: For example, with “Family members” the form gives that many rows by itself. The question then takes a value from 0 to 50.

ready.title: Ready forms
ready.intro: Forms are built and published here. A PM places a published form on a project.
ready.kind_hint: A beneficiary application form publishes only once its seven identity questions are marked.

steps.title: Steps to publish
steps.body: Draft → arrange the questions → preview → publish. A published version never changes; a change makes a new version, and earlier applications keep their version.

place.title: Place a ready form
place.note: A placed form arrives published on the project. It is not changed here; when the ready form has a newer version, you can take it.
place.none: No published ready form to place yet. Ask the Monitoring Team.
place.placed_note: This form was placed from a ready form, so it is not changed here.
place.newer: This form has a newer version (version {n}). Taking it starts the new version on the project; earlier applications keep theirs.
